title: Semilinear equivariant projective Chow modification
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be an integral finite-type $k$-scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let a finite group $H$ act on $X$ and $k$ compatibly with the structure morphism. Compatibility means that the structure map commutes with each pair of scheme and field automorphisms; the action need not be faithful. Then there are an integral finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, a compatible $H$-action on $T$, and an $H$-equivariant proper surjective morphism $q:T\to X$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism] which is an isomorphism over a dense open subscheme of $X$ [def-weil-open-immersion], such that both $T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $q$ admit closed immersions into finite-dimensional projective spaces over their respective targets [def-kun-projective, def-weil-closed-immersion]. In particular $q$ identifies $k(T)$ with $k(X)$ [def-sc-function-field].

source.place: Tag 0200, lemma-chow-Noetherian, followed by the finite product of semilinear translates and the schematic closure of their common dense open; constructions.tex Tag 01WD, lemma-segre-embedding. Equivariant averaging is the construction referenced in de Jong (1997) §2.10, printed p.605.

proof.text: Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and write $f:X\to S$. A field is Noetherian: an ideal containing a nonzero element contains $1$, so its only ideals are $(0)$ and $(1)$. Thus $S$ is affine Noetherian. Since $X$ is integral it is reduced. Apply [lem-fin-noetherian-chow-modification] to obtain $\pi:Y\to X$, proper and an isomorphism over a dense open $U_0\subset X$, with $Y$ projective over $S$. Here projective means a closed immersion $i:Y\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_S$ for some finite $n$, as in [def-pc-projective-morphism]. Also $X$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian].

source.place: Tag 0200, lemma-chow-Noetherian, specialized to a proper scheme over a field; the proper-source immersion is closed as in the existing modification node.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-semilinear-translated-modification-product] to $f,\pi,i$ and the given compatible actions. It supplies the copies $q_g=a_g\pi$, each with its finite projective-space embedding over $S$, their fibre product $r:P\to X$, and its semilinear action $A_h$. It also supplies a dense invariant open $U\subset X$ and the equivariant open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow P$ inverse to $P\times_XU\to U$.

source.place: Tag 01WF, lemma-H-projective-base-change; explicit finite-translate construction in the returned proof of lem-sfb-semilinear-equivariant-chow-modification, steps 2, 4 and 5. The averaging route is referenced in de Jong (1997), §2.10, printed p.605 (locally WANTED); the precise action and common-open argument are agent-written.

proof.text: The map $f$ is separated because it is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $H$ is finite and nonempty. Apply [lem-sfb-projective-fibre-product-closed-model] to the family $(q_g)_{g\in H}$. It gives a closed immersion $P\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_S$, $N=(n+1)^{|H|}-1$, and proves that $P$ is Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 01WD, lemma-segre-embedding; schemes.tex Tag 01KR, lemma-fibre-product-after-map; morphisms.tex Tag 0C4Q, lemma-projective-permanence (closed-graph proof in the finite-space convention), Tag 01WC, lemma-locally-projective-proper, and Tag 01T6, lemma-finite-type-noetherian. Returned proof steps 3 and 8 and the projective ambient Noetherianity part of step 6.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-invariant-integral-open-schematic-closure] to $r:P\to X$, its actions, and $U$. Its hypotheses hold by the preceding two steps and integrality of $X$. For $c:T=\operatorname{SIm}(j)\hookrightarrow P$ and $q=rc$, it gives integral $T$, a compatible action making $q$ equivariant, an isomorphism $q^{-1}(U)\simeq U$, and the isomorphism of the actual generic stalks induced by $q$, identifying $k(X)$ with $k(T)$.

source.place: Tag 056B, lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced; Tag 01R8, lemma-quasi-compact-scheme-theoretic-image, including restriction to an open and the ideal kernel; Tag 01RW, definition-function-field, and Tag 01RV, lemma-integral-scheme-rational-functions. Returned proof steps 6 (closure and restriction), 7 (invariant ideal and descended action), and 9 (generic stalk map); action descent is agent-explicit.

proof.text: Use the closed-model conclusion of [lem-sfb-projective-fibre-product-closed-model] for $c:T\hookrightarrow P$. It provides closed immersions $T\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_S$ and $T\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_X$, and properness and finite type of both structure maps. Its final clause applies to the dense open $U$ from step 4 and proves that $q$ is surjective. These are all the remaining clauses.

lean.note: The finite-type hypothesis on X is included in IsProper f (LocallyOfFiniteType and QuasiCompact). The actions are homomorphisms to the existing automorphism groups. The final canonical function-field identification is expressed directly as the stalk-map isomorphism at the generic point of T, whose image is the generic point of X; no arbitrary field isomorphism is substituted.
